answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose a Coherence‑Speaker‑Aware NCT (CSA‑NCT) training framework to improve the NCT model... We validate our CSA‑NCT framework on the datasets of different language pairs: BCon‑TrasT (En⇔De) and BMELD (En⇔Zh).
answer_1.outputs: Translated chat utterances in the target language

answer_2.quote: We use the Sacre‑BLEU and TER with the statistical significance test.

answer_4.quote: Finally, we assign the translated utterances and their corresponding dialogue history utterances in target language to three postgraduate human annotators, and ask them to make evaluations from the above three criteria.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators evaluate each translation according to three questions: (1) Coherence – whether the translation is semantically coherent with the dialogue history; (2) Speaker – whether the translation preserves the personality of the speaker; (3) Fluency – whether the translation is fluent and grammatically correct.
